result:
Route them by who has to act. The lead-replied email should go to Brandon only, because he is the one who picks up the phone and works the lead. Include the lead's actual reply text in the message rather than a summary, and link or attach the pitch folder so he has context on the call.

The lead-signed email is different: that one goes to you, Nate, because signing means a client needs onboarding, and Brandon can be copied on it too. Don't email you on every reply. The noise is what you'd end up filtering out, and you can always see progress on the dashboard. As a rule for any new notification type, ask who acts on it and email only them.
